notes.zh: 审阅注：这是提亚奇（太空鲸）首次接触的第二阶段 tiyanki_stage_2（难度3）事件；第一阶段是 first_contact_critters.10（故事 event-first-contact-critters-10），其唯一选项进入本阶段。本事件结束首次接触（finish_first_contact_effect），并向所有者隐藏发出 grand_archive.200（原始呼唤起源在此接入）。
notes.en: Review note: this is stage 2 (tiyanki_stage_2, difficulty 3) of the Tiyanki first contact; stage 1 is first_contact_critters.10 (story event-first-contact-critters-10), whose single option enters this stage. The event ends first contact (finish_first_contact_effect) and fires the hidden grand_archive.200 to the owner, where the Primal Calling origin hooks in.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项按本方类型互斥出现——唯灵、唯物或格式塔（无探索协议）、机械探索协议、其余；全部都给“太空鲸武器”科技选项/进度（已有选项则进度更多），其余类型中排外、军国或杀戮帝国额外增加猎杀数。
notes.en: Review note: the options are mutually exclusive by empire type: spiritualist, materialist or gestalt (without the exploration protocol), machine exploration protocol, and everyone else. All grant the space-whale weapon tech option/progress (more if the option was already open); in the last group xenophobes, militarists and homicidal empires also raise the hunted-fauna count.

scope.zh: 提亚奇首次接触的两个阶段：第一阶段「怪异热源」（10）与第二阶段「提亚奇」（15），含选项、结束首次接触及与原始呼唤起源的衔接。
scope.en: Both stages of the Tiyanki first contact: stage 1 "Weird Heat Blobs" (10) and stage 2 "Tiyanki" (15), with options, the end of first contact and the Primal Calling hook.
